evidence.title: MDXEditor - the Rich Text Markdown Editor React Component
GitHub - mdx-editor/editor: A rich text editor React component for markdown

name: MDXEditor
summary: Open-source React component for WYSIWYG markdown editing, with tables, code blocks, JSX and a configurable toolbar.
description: A React component that lets users author markdown in a rich-text editor instead of an edit/preview split. It covers core markdown plus extensions such as tables, images, code blocks with syntax highlighting and optional CodeMirror, links, front matter, JSX components and custom directives, with a diff/source view, customizable toolbar and tunable markdown output. MIT licensed, documented at mdxeditor.dev.
contains: React component for WYSIWYG markdown editing
table editor, link dialog, image support and front-matter editor
code blocks with syntax highlighting, optional CodeMirror editing
built-in JSX component editing and custom directive editors
configurable markdown output (bullet style, emphasis markers, whitespace)
